cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Be There for Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to show up, help, or stay involved as proof that the connection still matters.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Dad, will you come to my opening? Even for ten minutes?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't know anything about sculpture.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. You survived every school play. I still want you in my corner.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your mother will be there. We haven't spoken since the divorce.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come before we open. I'll unpack the biggest piece with you. I want a memory of tonight with you in it too.

mechanism: A uses exhibition handling expertise to give a reluctant father a precise pre-opening role, pursuing his presence despite lack of art knowledge and divorce discomfort.
confusable: D74 delays departure for repair; D73 seeks someone to show up because the relationship matters.
comparison: Kitchen alternative protects grief-laden marks; opening alternative schedules father before mother and offers supervised unpacking.
seedUse: Dad invitation, sculpture ignorance, school history and divorce timing derive from D73-b; S03 adds exact lifting guidance and arrival schedule.
